# graviteeam_protected_resource (Resource)

Manages a Gravitee AM Protected Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graviteeam_protected_resource" "example" {
  domain_id            = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  name                 = "MCP Server"
  type                 = "MCP_SERVER"
  description          = "Example protected MCP server"
  resource_identifiers = ["https://api.example.com/mcp"]

  feature {
    key         = "list_items"
    type        = "MCP_TOOL"
    description = "List items"
    scopes      = ["openid"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain this protected resource belongs to
- `name` (String) The name of the protected resource
- `resource_identifiers` (Set of String) Set of resource identifiers protected by this resource
- `type` (String) The protected resource type (for example, MCP_SERVER)

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the protected resource
- `feature` (Block List) Protected resource feature, such as an MCP tool definition (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--feature))
- `settings_json` (String) JSON object for advanced protected resource settings. The value is sent as the Gravitee AM settings payload.

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) The OAuth2 client ID generated by Gravitee AM
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) The OAuth2 client secret generated by Gravitee AM. Gravitee AM only returns the clear value at creation time.
- `id` (String) The ID of the protected resource

<a id="nestedblock--feature"></a>
### Nested Schema for `feature`

Required:

- `key` (String) The feature key
- `type` (String) The feature type (for example, MCP_TOOL)

Optional:

- `description` (String) The feature description
- `scopes` (Set of String) OAuth2 scopes required by this feature
